note: Expanded golden dataset (Objective G). Expectations are hand-specified and implementation-independent: each Central-Time wall time is materialized to a UTC instant by the Python tz database (zoneinfo) in the test, then asserted against ct_session / causal_label_contract. Extends golden_bars_v1 + golden_labels_v1 with DST, session-boundary, holiday, half-day, missing-minute, duplicate, synthetic-provenance, and barrier research-assumption cases.
half_day_note: 2026-11-27 early close 13:00 ET == 12:00 CT; a bar at 12:30 CT is after-hours on that day but would be RTH on a normal day.
label_edge_cases_note: Constructed inline in tests/test_stage1_golden_expansion.py from a self-contained contiguous bar set (aligned to the 60s grid). Expectations: missing forward bar -> outcome NULL with reconstructable True; missing interior bar -> MFE/MAE fail-closed (reconstructable False); duplicate anchor -> CausalLabelError; threshold 0 -> flat.

synthetic_provenance_case.description: A forward bar flagged synthetic must still produce the label (formula unchanged) AND report synthetic_involved=True so Stage 2 can stratify.

barrier_research_assumption.description: The triple-barrier target's idealized fill at the exact barrier price (no slippage, guaranteed touch fill) is a RESEARCH ASSUMPTION, not an execution-modeled fill. It must be labelled as such and never treated as tradeable realism in Stage 1.
